verdict.rationale: Motion publishes a live llms.txt at usemotion.com. A runtime probe confirmed it serves a text/plain, agent-oriented overview of the calendar, meeting assistant, tasks and pricing, and it mentions API access for projects and tasks. It reads as a product and marketing overview rather than a developer docs index, and the docs subdomain answers /llms.txt with an HTML app shell. missing for 10: llms.txt or agent-oriented index on docs.usemotion.com covering the API reference, llms-full.txt or markdown docs depth, independent/community corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: https://www.usemotion.com/llms.txt served a text/plain agent-oriented overview ('# Usemotion') covering the AI calendar, meeting assistant, tasks, and pricing
API access for creating, updating, and managing projects and tasks.
